Mr. J. S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate

This is an appeal preferred under Section 383 
of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 from the 
jail. 
There is delay of 27 days.
Smt. Sudha Tamta is appointed as Amicus
Curiae in this case, keeping in view of the fact that 
the appellant is in custody. 
Let Smt. Sudha Tamta, learned counsel be 
intimated about her engagement in this case for the 
appellant. 
In that view of the matter, we are inclined to 
condone the delay of 27 days.
Heard.
Admit.
Call for the scanned copies (both soft and 
hard) of the Trial Court Records.
The Registry is directed to prepare paper 
book after receiving the Trial Court Records and 
supply the same to the learned counsel appearing 
for the parties.
List this matter on 11.04.2023.
Delay condonation application (IA No. 1 of 
2023) stands disposed of.
